mainEntity.name: Can I create a QR menu for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can create a fully free digital menu for your restaurant or cafe in minutes, add items, prices, and photos, and get a QR code ready to use—no hassle.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the free plan and paid subscription?

acceptedAnswer.text: The free plan covers the essentials to run a professional menu. Paid plans add features such as full design control, brand colours, promotions or ads, and a richer experience for your guests (see current pricing for details).

mainEntity.name: Does the menu support Arabic and English?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The platform supports Arabic and English so you can choose what works for your customers—ideal for locals and tourists alike.

mainEntity.name: Is the dashboard easy to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built a simple, fast dashboard where you can add or edit items and prices, update your menu anytime, and see changes go live without technical skills.

mainEntity.name: Can I manage more than one menu or branch?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your plan: the free tier often allows one active menu, while higher plans support multiple menus or advanced features. Check pricing or your dashboard for your current limits.

mainEntity.name: How do I share the menu with customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: After you publish your menu you get a direct link and a QR code. Put the code on tables, printed menus, or social media—customers scan or tap the link and browse instantly.

mainEntity.name: Is my restaurant data and menu protected?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work to keep the platform secure and host your data with reasonable safeguards. Read our privacy policy for details on collection and use, and use a strong password—never share login credentials.

mainEntity.name: What if I need help or run into an issue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact us via WhatsApp or email as shown on the site—we can help you set up your menu or troubleshoot technical issues.

mainEntity.name: Can I customise the menu look, colours, and logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Depending on your plan you can upload a logo and adjust colours and layout to match your brand; higher tiers offer broader design control.
